title: Run a product beta or design-partner program
summary: Before broad release when a product needs controlled validation with selected users. A reviewed beta outcome with user feedback, operational readiness and an explicit launch or further-test decision.
outcomes: A reviewed beta outcome with user feedback, operational readiness and an explicit launch or further-test decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before broad release when a product needs controlled validation with selected users.

parts.title: Define the learning goals and eligibility
parts.guidance: State the product behavior to test, target users, known limitations and evidence needed for a decision. Identify data sensitivity and risks that would make a participant or use case unsuitable.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the participant terms and safeguards
parts.guidance: Product, security and legal owners review beta access, support, confidentiality, data handling and exit arrangements. Confirm that participation does not imply production readiness or permission for an otherwise regulated use.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve the participant terms and safeguards

parts.title: Provision the approved beta environment
parts.guidance: Invite only approved participants and configure limited access, monitoring and recovery. Test onboarding and support routes and record the software version and features each cohort receives.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Collect feedback and operating evidence
parts.guidance: Track adoption, task success, defects, incidents and qualitative feedback against the learning goals. Maintain a reproducible issue register while minimizing personal data in reports.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Decide whether to launch, extend or stop
parts.guidance: The accountable owners review the evidence, unresolved risks and support capacity. Communicate the approved decision, migrate or remove beta access appropriately and hand launch work to the release process.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Decide whether to launch, extend or stop

verify.how: A reviewed beta outcome with user feedback, operational readiness and an explicit launch or further-test decision.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
